'''Clone medical officers''' were [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medics]] who served on [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical stations]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were sometimes stationed on [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class star destroyers]] if they were needed.

==History==
Trained in healing like [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Medic/Legends|medics]], [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] medical [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were specifically stationed aboard [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] [[Space station/Legends|stations]] and [[Starship/Legends|ships]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], such as the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]],<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> while other medics served on the war's front lines.<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

Clone medical officers wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] version of the standard [[Clone trooper officer/Legends|clone officer]] [[Republic military uniform|uniform]] with an additional badge on the wearer's left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] indicating an individuals' medical specialty.<ref name="TCWCE" />
